name: Dark Lord
source:
Nexton presents a dark fantasy erotic game where you play the evil overlord on a quest to rule the world. Seduce and dominate princesses, priestess, knights and other fantasy girls to build a harem that will assist in your quest.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG8227]J-List[/url]]
translation:
Nexton推出的黑暗奇幻成人游戏。你将扮演企图征服世界的邪恶领主，通过诱惑并支配公主、女祭司、女骑士等奇幻世界中的女性，建立一支协助你完成霸业的后宫。

[译自[url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG8227]J-List[/url]]
